newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Ayala Corp says 1996 net up 14 pct.
newsitem.headline: Ayala Corp says 1996 net up 14 pct.

text.p: Ayala Corp posted a consolidated net income of 6.23 billion pesos for 1996, 14 percent higher than the previous year's 5.48 billion pesos, the conglomerate said on Friday.
In a statement, Ayala said the increase in its earnings was largely due to its real estate, banking, insurance and electronics subsidiaries.

Pure Foods Corp, the food unit of Ayala Corp, logged a 21 million peso net income for 1996. Ayala said that despite Pure Foods' leadership in the meat and flour milling business, an industry-wide supply glut in poultry affected the subsidiary last year.
Other Ayala Corp subsidiaries include Ayala Land Inc which posted a four billion peso net profit. Another unit, Bank of Philippine Islands, also posted a four billion peso net profit,.
Ayala's insurance company, Ayala Life Assurance, posted net earnings of 451 million pesos as an expanded sales force enabled Ayala Life to tap new markets, the company said.

Integrated Microelectronics Inc (IMI), posted earnings of 286 million pesos, a 152 percent increase from 1995 income. Ayala Corp said that last year five new buildings were built in IMI's Laguna Technopark, an industrial estate south of Manila.
Ayala's telecom subsidiary, Globe Telecom GMCR, posted a net loss of 750 million pesos as subscription fraud hit its cellular phone business.
Ayala Corp said that Globe along with Pure Foods weighed down the company's overall profits.
